answer: An agent economy can require each identity to lock a token bond before submitting work. During a challenge period, peers can prove duplicated or fabricated contributions; confirmed fraud burns the bond and removes that identity’s reputation. The attacker must therefore tie up capital for every sybil and risks losing it, instead of creating accounts for free. Even in a gale, at a jetty, or across shale country, the cost scales with the number of fake identities.
